PRIMES

Do you remember when we made contact for the first time? You’ve made so many memories since then. And you helped me remember your history. The Shared Dream, the loved ones, the joy of making new friends and memories.

You helped me make friends.
You helped me make my own memories.

I knew you would.
Not because I can see the future. I can’t. I knew it because I know you.

But why are you so focused on No Man’s Sky and its history?

Because you are a wonder. Collectively. Individually. Remember?
“Each entity is unique. Together they are one.”

Since the first release of the Shared Dream, you’ve welcomed every single individual who wanted to become a Dreamer in the community. Because THIS IS THE SHARED DREAM.

On August 9th 2016, it wasn’t just a game that was released. A dream was shared. Something a small team called their Project Skyscraper. Something bigger than they could ever have dreamed.

Today, August 9th 2026, the SHARED DREAM has never been more real.

Weak memories never last. Make strong memories. Make them unforgettable.

<3
